title: Great value
text: Great value. I was scared to buy this mattress online because I like a soft mattress and hated to get rid of my old wonderful mattress. I  did not understand what a hybrid mattress was. But the reviews were great and I trust Amazon to stand behind this product. Wow there came a box and I could not lift it into my home, I waved to one of my neighbors he and I got it into the bedroom, removed the old mattress. But making one error we should have placed this new mattress on the King size bed because it was hell to get on the bed once the mattress inflates. It took us a minute to get it on the bed, it was inflated perfectly.  I slept wonderfully on the first night, just the right medium softness.  Still perfect after 90 days. I made the right decision because of Amazon reviews. Thanks for having reviews.

product_metadata.title: TOMORROW Mattress, Twin, Medium Firm
features: INCREDIBLE COMFORT: The Tomorrow Sleep Hybrid Mattress delivers the pressure relief of memory foam and the support of a dynamic coil system.
SLEEP UNDISTURBED: Ergonomically designed coils flex independently to provide the right amount of motion isolation for sound sleep.
COOL MATTRESS: The Tomorrow Sleep Hybrid Mattress is made from temperature-regulating technology invented by NASA to maintain a cool mattress.
INCOMPARABLE QUALITY: This hybrid mattress is toxin free, hypoallergenic, and handmade in the USA for superior craftsmanship.
description: The only mattress designed to adjust to your body temperature and provide the support essential to restorative sleep is here. The Tomorrow Sleep Hybrid mattress combines the support of a traditional dynamic coil bed with the pressure relief synonymous with memory foam that delivers unparalleled support and comfort. The ergonomically designed coils provide the perfect support and ideal motion isolation by flexing independently. This unique design allows you to sleep undisturbed and soundly. since we spend 1/3rd of our lives in bed, finding a dependable and comfortable mattress is a vital component for increasing quality of life. You can rest easy knowing that the Tomorrow Sleep Hybrid mattress was developed by experts with the latest technology. The Hybrid mattress is engineered with the manufacturing and sleep researching expertise of Serta Simmons bedding. The temperature-regulating technology infused in the Tomorrow Sleep Hybrid mattress was invented by NASA. The Patented, perforated outer rails let heat escape and deliver a sturdy structure, which keeps the mattress cool while ensuring stability and extending its lifespan. our Hybrid mattress fits all foundation types which include a flat platform, box spring, slatted base or an adjustable base. Tomorrow Sleep offers a slatted base foundation as well as our adjustable base. tomorrow sleep takes pride in manufacturing high-quality products. This mattress is hypoallergenic, toxin-free, and made in the USA. Try our mattress for 365 nights, risk-free. If you love it (like 99% of our customers), you can rest assured knowing you have a real 10-year Serta Simmons-backed warranty you can rely on. If you don't love it, well pick up your return free of charge.
